question: Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. parent company owner
markdown:
Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Huawei Investment & Holding Co., Ltd., which is controlled by an employee shareholding scheme through a trade union committee, with founder Ren Zhengfei owning about 1% and having limited veto power. The company has 213,000 employees, operates in over 170 countries, and serves more than three billion people.
Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Huawei Investment & Holding Co., Ltd.
Huawei Investment & Holding Co., Ltd. controls Huawei Technologies.
Roughly 99% of the holding company is owned by an employee shareholding scheme through a trade union committee.
Over 160,000 employees and retired staff hold shares in Huawei.
Founder Ren Zhengfei owns around 1% of the company and retains limited veto power.
The highest decision-making body is the Employee Shareholders' Representative Commission.
Huawei has 213,000 employees and operates in over 170 countries and regions, serving more than three billion people.
Huawei Investment & Holding Co., Ltd. is a private company wholly owned by 161,749 of its employees and retired beneficiaries.
Huawei Technologies Co Ltd is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Shenzhen Huawei Investment & Holding Co., Ltd.
Ren Zhengfei (b. 25 Oct 1944) is founder and CEO of Huawei Technologies, Shenzhen, China.
Huawei was founded on 15 Sep 1987.
